items.source: Creates an extended ReplaceRootOperation.ReplaceRootDocumentOperation that combines ReplaceRootOperation.ReplacementDocuments from the currentOperation and extension operation.
items.translation: 创建一个扩展的ReplaceRootOperation.ReplaceRootDocumentOperation，该操作结合了当前操作和扩展操作中的ReplaceRootOperation.ReplacementDocument。

items.source: Creates a new ReplaceRootOperation.ReplaceRootDocumentOperation that merges all existing replacement values with values from value.
items.translation: 创建一个新的ReplaceRootOperation.ReplaceRootDocumentOperation，该操作将合并所有现有的替换值与来自 value 的值。

items.source: Support for the MongoDB aggregation framework.
items.translation: 支持 MongoDB 聚合框架。

items.source: Defines a root document replacement based on a composable document that is empty initially.
items.translation: 定义了一个基于初始为空的可组合文档的根文档替换。
